bio.heading: hi, i'm alex.
bio.portraitPlaceholder: photo goes here — board in hand, slopes behind.
bio.p1: for the past 8 years i've been teaching snowboarding on the slopes of bansko — from first-timers strapping in for the very first run, to advanced riders refining their technique.
bio.p2: over 500 students from more than 12 countries have ridden with me. every lesson is a real conversation — no conveyor-belt group sessions, no rushed drills.

meeting.title: where we meet.
meeting.directions: exact spot: the benches by the gondola entrance. i'll be wearing a black jacket with a green carbon snowboard. we sort out lift pass and gear before riding up.

equipment.q: do i need my own snowboard and boots?
equipment.a: no. rentals are easy in bansko — plenty of shops near the gondola. tell me your level and i'll recommend a shop and the right board size.

clothing.q: what should i wear for the first lesson?
clothing.a: waterproof jacket and pants, thermal base layer, warm socks (just one pair, not two), gloves, helmet, and goggles. no cotton. rent or bring — both work.

groupSize.q: how many people in a group lesson?
groupSize.a: max four riders, always at a similar level. i check the level over whatsapp before we meet so the pacing works for everyone.

minAge.q: what's the youngest age for kids lessons?
minAge.a: six years old. younger kids usually don't have the attention span for a full session. exceptions are possible — message me.

language.q: what language is the lesson in?
language.a: english or bulgarian, whichever you prefer. i switch mid-sentence if that helps — fluent in both.

weather.q: what if there's no snow or bad weather?
weather.a: bansko has great snowmaking so conditions are usually rideable from december through april. severe storms: we reschedule at no cost.

cancellation.a: free cancellation up to 48 hours before the lesson. inside 48 hours, a 30% fee applies. rescheduling to another date is always free.

location.a: at the gondola base in bansko town (not on the mountain). we ride the gondola up together and pick the slope that matches your level.

liftPass.a: no. lift passes are bought at the cashier by the gondola — around €45 per day. i can help you pick the right duration.

payment.a: cash in euros or bulgarian leva on the day of the first lesson. no online payment required.

terms.title: terms of service
terms.subtitle: the rules for booking and taking a snowboard lesson with ridewithalex. plain-language summary — no fine print traps.

service.title: what i offer
service.p1: ridewithalex is a snowboard instruction service operated by alex (the instructor) in bansko, bulgaria. lessons are offered one-on-one, for small groups (max four riders), and for children from age six.
service.p2: by booking a lesson you confirm that you've read and agreed to these terms. if something here isn't clear, ask before booking — easier than sorting it out after.

booking.title: booking and reservations
booking.p1: bookings are made through the contact channels listed on the site (phone, whatsapp, email, instagram). a booking is confirmed once alex replies with a confirmed date and meeting time.
booking.p2: please provide a valid phone number at booking. we may need to reach you the day before or the morning of the lesson about weather or conditions.

payment.title: payment
payment.p1: payment is made in cash on the day of the first lesson, in euros or bulgarian leva at the current daily exchange rate. no online payment or deposit is required.
payment.p2: receipts are available on request. for multi-day packages (full day, week), the total is paid at the start of the first day unless another arrangement is agreed in advance.

cancellation.title: cancellation and rescheduling
cancellation.p1: you can cancel a booking free of charge up to 48 hours before the scheduled start. cancellations made within 48 hours may be subject to a 30% fee to cover the reserved time.
cancellation.p2: rescheduling to another available date is always free, regardless of how close to the original date you contact us. just message early if you can.

weather.title: weather and conditions
weather.p1: snowboard lessons depend on mountain conditions. if weather or avalanche risk makes a lesson unsafe, alex will contact you to reschedule at no cost.
weather.p2: you can also cancel free of charge if you decide the conditions don't suit you, even inside the 48-hour window — just tell us before we start the lift ride up.

equipment.title: equipment and gear
equipment.p1: you are responsible for your own snowboard, boots, helmet, goggles, and weather-appropriate clothing. alex can recommend a rental shop in bansko if needed.
equipment.p2: a helmet is strongly recommended and required for riders under 18. lift passes are not included in the lesson price and must be purchased separately at the gondola.

liability.title: liability and assumption of risk
liability.p1: snowboarding involves inherent risks, including falls, collisions, and injuries. by participating in a lesson you acknowledge these risks and agree that alex is not liable for injuries or losses resulting from the activity itself.
liability.p2: alex maintains appropriate instructor certification and follows established safety practices. you are encouraged to carry personal travel or sports insurance covering winter sports.

minors.title: minors (under 18)
minors.p1: riders under 18 must be booked by a parent or legal guardian. the guardian is responsible for providing accurate medical information, allergies, and any special needs at the time of booking.
minors.p2: for children under 12, the guardian must be present at the meeting point at the start and end of each lesson. alex does not assume responsibility for children outside lesson hours.

intellectualProperty.title: photos, videos, and intellectual property
intellectualProperty.p1: alex may take photos or short videos during lessons for coaching feedback and, occasionally, for use on the ridewithalex website and instagram account.
intellectualProperty.p2: if you do not want your image used publicly, please say so at booking or any time before the lesson. we will honor the request without explanation.

changes.title: changes and governing law
changes.p1: these terms may be updated occasionally. the date at the top of this page shows when they were last revised. continued use of the service after an update means you accept the new terms.
changes.p2: these terms are governed by the laws of the republic of bulgaria. any disputes will be resolved, where possible, through direct conversation. formal disputes fall under the jurisdiction of the courts of blagoevgrad district.
